pages.text: The second step of CyberFarm power is $(l)gas$(): fuel that your farm and your mob traps make for you. This page shows how the gas machines fit together, and how to carry gases in $(l)buckets$(): Biogas, Methane and Steam Buckets.$(br)$(li)$(item)Biogas Bucket$()

$(li)$(l)Biogas$(): a $(l:generators/biomass_press)Biomass Press$(/l) presses farm waste into Biomass, and a $(l:generators/bio_digester)Bio-Digester$(/l) turns it into Biogas.$(br)$(li)$(l)Methane$(): a mob shut in the chamber of a $(l:generators/methane_extractor)Methane Extractor$(/l) dissolves in Acid and gives off Methane.
pages.title: The two gases

pages.text: Two generators burn both gases: the $(l:generators/gas_turbine)Gas Turbine$(/l), small and cheap, and the $(l:generators/steam_engine)Steam Engine$(/l), a bigger build that gets more out of every mB.$(br)$(li)$(l:generators/biomass_press)Biomass Press$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:generators/bio_digester)Bio-Digester$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:generators/methane_extractor)Methane Extractor$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:generators/gas_turbine)Gas Turbine$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:generators/steam_engine)Steam Engine$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipe$(/l)

A typical setup: a Bio-Digester and the Methane Outlet of an extraction chamber push their gas into $(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipes$(/l). The pipes carry it to a Gas Turbine or a Steam Engine. The generator pushes FE into $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduits$(/l) that power your drones' docks.

$(li)$(l)Biogas$(): Bio-Digester, 10 mB/t, 5 FE per mB, 9 FE per mB$(br)$(li)$(l)Methane$(): Methane Extractor, up to 50 mB/t, 12 FE per mB, 15 FE per mB$(br)How long the gas lasts and what it gives (a bucket is 1,000 mB):
pages.title: Numbers

pages.text: $(li)$(l)1,000 mB of Biogas$(): 5,000 FE, 2.5 seconds at 100 FE/t, 9,000 FE, about 1.1 seconds at 405 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)1,000 mB of Methane$(): 12,000 FE, 2.5 seconds at 240 FE/t, 15,000 FE, about 1.1 seconds at 675 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)One Biomass (500 mB of Biogas)$(): 2,500 FE, 4,500 FE

$(li)$(l)One zombie in the chamber (300,000 mB of Methane)$(): 3,600,000 FE, 4,500,000 FE$(br)Gas is made slowly and burned fast, so what counts is the $(l)flow$():$(br)$(li)$(l)Gas Turbine$(): 20 mB/t, two Bio-Digesters, or two fifths of a zombie chamber
$(li)$(l)Steam Engine$(): 45 mB/t, a little less than one zombie chamber

The Biomass Press and the Bio-Digester draw $(l)8 FE/t$() each, so the first power has to come from elsewhere, such as a $(l:generators/combustion_generator)Combustion Generator$(/l). At full speed a digester and one press cost 16 FE/t together. Their gas gives 50 FE/t in a Gas Turbine, or 90 FE/t in a Steam Engine.
Gases can be carried in buckets. The buckets are held $(l)upside down$(), since gas is lighter than air.
pages.title: Gas buckets

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Fill one$(): right-click a machine or tank holding at least 1,000 mB of gas with an $(l)empty bucket$(). Biogas comes from a Bio-Digester, Methane from a Methane Outlet of the extraction chamber, Steam from a $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l) port or a $(l:nuclear/steam_turbine)Steam Turbine$(/l).
$(li)$(l)Empty it$(): right-click a machine, a Reactor Port or a tank of any mod to pour the 1,000 mB in.$(br)$(li)A gas cannot be poured into the world: it would just float away.

$(li)Both gases are $(l)standard fluids$(). Tanks, pipes and machines of other mods that handle fluids can store and move them too.$(br)$(li)They are tagged forge:gaseous, forge:biogas and forge:methane.
